parameters.query:
SELECT l.*, t.access_token, i.destino, i.destino_config, i.origen_sf 
FROM meli_leads l 
JOIN meli_tokens t ON l.user_id = t.user_id 
JOIN meli_integraciones i ON l.user_id = i.user_id 
WHERE l.status = 'active' 
AND l.buyer_id IS NOT NULL 
AND l.buyer_id != 0
AND l.buyer_nombre IS NOT NULL
AND l.user_id = 3505679485
LIMIT 100

SELECT * FROM meli_asesores 
WHERE user_id = {{ $json.user_id }} 
AND (
  RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '{{ $json.asesor_sufijo1 }}'
  OR RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '{{ $json.asesor_sufijo2 }}'
  OR telefono IS NULL
  OR telefono = ''
)
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '{{ $json.asesor_sufijo1 }}' THEN 0
    WHEN RIGHT(REGEXP_REPLACE(telefono, '[^0-9]', ''), 8) = '{{ $json.asesor_sufijo2 }}' THEN 1
    ELSE 2 
  END
LIMIT 1
UPDATE meli_leads SET status = 'skipped' WHERE id = '{{ $('Loop leads').item.json.id }}'
